name: category_id
description: Top-level category of the series: expenditures, income, consumer unit characteristics or addenda

name: subcategory_id
description: Subcategory code, e.g. food, housing or income before taxes

name: item_id
description: Item code, either a 6-digit numeric code or a mnemonic such as TOTALEXP

name: item_display_level
description: Indentation level of the item in the BLS table hierarchy, from 0 (top) to 3
observations: Ordinal position in the published table tree

name: demographics_id
description: Demographic classification the series is cut by, e.g. LB01 all consumer units or LB02 income quintiles

name: characteristics_id
description: Group within the demographic classification, e.g. a specific income quintile

name: characteristics_name
description: Name of the group within the demographic classification

name: statistic
description: Statistic published in the series; M is the mean

name: series_title
description: Full title of the series as published by BLS

name: begin_year
description: First year with data in the series

name: end_year
description: Last year with data in the series
